# Newsletter growth

**Grow an owned email list: a clear promise, a lead magnet, recommendations, swaps, referrals, clean deliverability, honest metrics.**

Grows an email newsletter for a creator or AI character on beehiiv, Substack, Kit or similar — one clear promise, a lead magnet, sign-up placement across social profiles and shorts, recommendations and cross-promotion swaps, reader referral programs, paid recommendations, deliverability basics (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, complaint rates), and the weekly metrics that matter (net growth, source mix, click rate, not opens). Use when someone wants more newsletter subscribers, is choosing a newsletter platform, wants a referral program or newsletter swap, sees growth stall or emails landing in spam, or asks how to turn social followers into an owned email list.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Grow](../README.md) | intermediate | 3 h setup, 1 h a week | — | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Write the one-line promise
2. Pick the platform for the growth tools
3. Set up clean sending before growth
4. Build one lead magnet
5. Put the sign-up everywhere you post
6. Grow through other newsletters
7. Add referrals once readers love it
8. Track the dashboard every week
9. Clean the list and run one experiment

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.
